mutations.name: unused_db_field
mutations.note: A column added to an existing model that no application code reads or writes. Detected by static ORM-column usage analysis (D-103/N).

mutations.name: backend_service_without_caller
mutations.note: A public service class no module references. Detected by static class-usage analysis (D-103/O).

mutations.name: frontend_control_without_behavior
mutations.note: A template event handler with no defined function. Detected by static Vue control-wiring analysis (D-103/P).

mutations.name: channel_aware_module_without_channel
mutations.note: Channel-aware code that bypasses the canonical Channel Registry.

mutations.name: write_only_setting
mutations.note: A setting with a real write path but no reader: saved, yet it never changes behaviour. Detected by static write/read analysis (D-100/M).

mutations.name: gateway_capability_without_anchor
mutations.note: The AI Gateway capability is marked implemented but its service anchor is removed: the capability would advertise a feature with no implementation behind it (D-099).

mutations.name: frontend_calls_missing_gateway_area
mutations.note: The frontend client calls an AI Gateway area the backend does not expose; the route would 404.

mutations.name: gateway_capability_depends_on_unimplemented
mutations.note: The AI Gateway is made to depend on the unimplemented media_conversion capability; the graph must fail instead of advertising a feature whose dependency cannot work (D-099).

mutations.name: gateway_provider_without_caller
mutations.note: A gateway provider class that no module references is dead functionality: registered in code, reachable by no scenario (O).

mutations.name: gateway_control_without_handler
mutations.note: An AI Gateway UI control whose handler is never defined: the owner clicks and nothing happens (P).

mutations.name: onboarding_deeplink_wrong_separator
mutations.note: The mass onboarding deep link must join admin rights with '+', not a space, or Telegram silently drops the requested rights (D-120).

mutations.name: onboarding_capability_without_anchor
mutations.note: The bot_onboarding capability must stay anchored to its service class, or it can claim to be implemented with no code (D-099/D-120).

mutations.name: orphan_setting_runtime
mutations.note: Detected by the runtime dead-setting check, not a static consumer graph.
